topics.summary: Graphical method to simplify Boolean expressions up to 4 variables.
key_formulas: Group size must be powers of 2 (1, 2, 4, 8, 16)
topics.worked_example:
Minimize F(A,B,C) = \sum m(1, 3, 5, 7).
Grouping all four ones gives a 2x2 quad covering C=1 across all A and B combinations.
Simplified Result: F = C.
